metadata.name: fmt2-pri-connectx-replacement
metadata.description: Replace or reseat the missing ConnectX adapter on kvm-sfo200-pri-9922 and reopen RDMA admission only after host, iDRAC, and Arista evidence passes.

variables.name: ansible_root
variables.description: Ansible root containing host E2ET definitions and playbooks.

variables.name: pri_host
variables.description: FMT2 R630 host requiring ConnectX replacement.

variables.name: arista_host
variables.description: Arista 7060 switch with pri ConnectX-facing ports Et6/1 and Et6/3.

variables.name: e2et_manifest
variables.description: Blocked admission manifest that must move from blocked to passing after replacement.

stages.summary: Freeze pri RDMA admission and confirm the replacement is a physical/topology maintenance action.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Gate: pri remains non-RDMA until ConnectX enumerates in Linux and iDRAC, Arista LLDP sees Et6/1+Et6/3 neighbors, vendor OFED/DOCA reports, and RDMA E2ET passes.'

stages.summary: Capture host PCI inventory, DMI slots, iDRAC hardware inventory, Arista interface state, LLDP, counters, and config snapshot before opening the chassis.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Capture before swap: lspci -Dnn; lspci -tvnn; dmidecode -t slot; iDRAC hwinventory; show interfaces status Et6/1,Et6/3; show lldp neighbors Et6/1,Et6/3 detail; show running-config interfaces Et6/1,Et6/3,Po613.'

stages.summary: Power off pri through iDRAC or OS shutdown, then verify power state before datacenter hands remove or replace the adapter.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Operator gate: power off pri and verify iDRAC chassis power is off before physical replacement. Do not touch sec, ter, or X12AGAIN.'

stages.summary: Replace or reseat the ConnectX adapter, record model, PSID, serial, port MACs, optics or DAC identifiers, riser, and slot.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Datacenter hands: install known-good ConnectX adapter in the intended pri PCIe slot, cable both ports back to Arista Et6/1 and Et6/3, and record FRU metadata for NetBox.'

stages.summary: Boot pri and validate Linux plus iDRAC can enumerate the replacement ConnectX adapter.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Post-swap required evidence: lspci -Dnn shows 15b3 Mellanox endpoint; dmidecode Slot 1 is In Use; iDRAC hardware inventory shows the adapter; Linux names both ConnectX ports.'

stages.summary: Validate Arista sees both pri ConnectX ports and that no unintended loop, LACP, VLAN, or LLDP behavior appeared.
command: printf '%s\n' 'Post-swap switch evidence: Et6/1 and Et6/3 link as expected, LLDP sees pri neighbors, counters are clean, Po613 remains blocked unless intentionally configured, and no topology loop or ARP flood appears.'

stages.summary: Render the pri RDMA E2ET conformance report; it must remain blocked until every hard gate is updated with post-swap passing evidence.
